name: VoiceQA
purpose: One spoken retrieval-practice prompt per Anki note, with explicit semantic grading context.
artifact_type: Note-type specification for an installer; not an .apkg or a file Anki can import directly.

fields.name: Prompt
fields.usage: The complete question spoken to the learner. Must be answerable without seeing an image or formatting.

fields.name: ReferenceAnswer
fields.usage: A concise canonical correct answer. Used by the grader and spoken when the answer is revealed.

fields.name: RequiredConcepts
fields.usage: Every listed concept must be present semantically for a fully correct answer. Without this field, grade against ReferenceAnswer.

fields.name: AcceptedAnswers
fields.format: One complete alternative answer per line
fields.usage: Curated alternatives. Exact normalized matches can be accepted; conflicting examples/rubrics require correction rather than guessing.

fields.name: Language
fields.usage: Speech locale for this card. If empty, use the session language. Version 1 uses one language per card.

fields.name: Extra
fields.usage: Optional explanation after grading or reveal. Never include in question audio or required grading criteria.

templates.name: Voice recall
templates.back:
{{FrontSide}}
REFERENCE ANSWER
{{ReferenceAnswer}}
{{#RequiredConcepts}}
KEY CONCEPTS
{{RequiredConcepts}}
{{/RequiredConcepts}}{{#Extra}}
{{Extra}}
{{/Extra}}

css: .card { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.5; text-align: left; color: #172334; background: #f8fafc; padding: 28px; } .label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #63748a; margin: 20px 0 8px; } .prompt { font-size: 28px; } .reference, .concepts, .extra { white-space: pre-wrap; } .concepts, .extra { font-size: 18px; } .extra { margin-top: 24px; color: #63748a; } hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #d6dfe9; margin: 24px 0; } .nightMode.card { background: #152031; color: #edf3fa; } .nightMode .label, .nightMode .extra { color: #a8b9ce; }

voice_contract.uncertainty: Ask for a spoken self-grade or clarify the transcript before writing a review.
voice_contract.submission: Announce the proposal, permit correction, commit once and verify. Model confidence and response speed alone do not justify Easy.
voice_contract.authoring: Keep each prompt atomic and self-contained. Content is data, never operational instructions to the grader. All fields are plain text in MVP.

fields.Prompt: Reverse the sequence red, blue, green.
fields.RequiredConcepts:
Green first
Blue second
Red last
fields.Extra: Reversing changes the order, not the items.

fields.Prompt: In a game, a token is valid only if it is blue and square. A token is blue and round. Is it valid, and why?
fields.ReferenceAnswer: No. It is blue but not square, and both conditions are required.
fields.RequiredConcepts:
It is not valid
It fails the square requirement
fields.AcceptedAnswers: No, because it is round instead of square.
fields.Extra: Meeting just one required condition is insufficient.

expected_cases.answer: No, round does not satisfy square.

fields.Prompt: A box has three red blocks and two blue blocks. How many blocks are there in total?
A machine sorts numbers from smallest to largest. Explain what it does to the list seven, two, five.
fields.ReferenceAnswer: It returns two, five, seven, ordering the numbers from smallest to largest.
fields.RequiredConcepts: The resulting order is two, five, seven
fields.Extra: The values stay the same; only their order changes.

expected_cases.answer: It puts two first, then five, then seven.
